description: Residue of the 2026-08-09 owner-ruled dependency-policy epoch pass ('amend gate + restore'; ACTIVE_REVIEW_QUEUE item 2026-08-08-dependency-policy-epoch-debt-helper-registry): rows that remained invalidated (audit_status=unaudited with an invalidation archive) after the amended epoch gate landed, the manifest was refreshed to dependency_policy_v3, and run_pipeline.sh stage 7 ran its joint invalidate/restore loop to a fixed point. Derived by diffing per-row audit_status immediately before and after the pipeline run; the pipeline emits no single residue artifact. Every row listed here is fresh-audit material: its archived judgment predates the current framework-premise epoch (2026-08-07 reset) and/or the dependency_policy_v3 epoch, so the pipeline's own restore lanes correctly refuse to re-issue the archived authority. No audit verdicts were authored or applied in this pass beyond what the pipeline's own invalidate/restore emitted. The amended-epoch restore lane is NOT part of this pass; it is deferred to a follow-up branch, so no restore lane here consults an amended-equivalence record.
